author: yaoztorun
name: istanblue
description: Animated WebGL shader background in the Waves style, generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. 5-color palette (#184557, #007FAD, #57B2CB, #EAF9FF, #007FAD). Features: cursor-reactive (swirl). A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
